hypothesis: Assahat daɣ dax war t- ijjit alwaq iyyan. Ismawan chund assuhu aqqalan a ojjaran i ad war addobat a tan-ijjit alwaq iyyan

source: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
reference: As teǧrawed isefran miɣ iharaten wi n asired n ikeddiwen dat n awa yebbaten ezday inin yeswaten yemmut.
hypothesis: Almaɣna wa olaɣan n as eqqal tamăšɣult daɣ ammas eqqal as ille tasăjrit n isuj n asiflas meɣ chemicals n ehan win eɣaf

source: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
reference: Ecwaḍet deɣ awa yektaben ful ssem waɣ ad tezdayem aberaqa ad yecmin.
hypothesis: Akayad ən təzart ye igi ən təzart ən alhak ən tamusne ten.

source: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
reference: Tǝfert tan bug axdǎmǎn sar ǝs entomolojist tan s almǎɣna n tǎqqǝmt ten n ǝmudǎrǎn.
hypothesis: Isim wan bug exdam entomologist tan daɣ almaɣna n isim n taqqimt ten n insect tan

source: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
reference: Tǝfert ten tǝzjǎr ǝd jǎmǎɣ wan aru ǝd Bed-bugs,amosnen ǝmudǎrǎn ǝjǎnen ǝ asǎmmǎdǎs n addinǎt.
hypothesis: Isim wen izjar id assahat n aru fal Bed-bugs, aqqalan imudaran wi ijjanen i ad ikrichan addinat

source: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
reference: Assǎssin-bugs d Bed-bugs fuk nǎsan amosǎn ǝmudǎrǎn tǎhǎjǝnen daɣ ǝskǎk nǎsan, ǝjǎnen ǝ tǎmudre daɣ askok meɣ ehǎn n ǝnǎftǎɣǎn nǎsan.
hypothesis: Assassin-bugs əd Bed-bugs aqalan nidicolous, amosan ayhan dǎɣ tamudre dǎɣ əšikəl meɣ dǎɣ təmuqunen ən amosan.

source: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
reference: Deɣ United States of America, llant 400,000 n addunet yerrinen Multiple Sclerosis (MS), awaɣ d turna tazzart i rinen ibaraḍen d inuba deɣ akal waɣ.
hypothesis: Daɣ Amrik, illan ti har 400,000 n ach-ak n Multiple Sclerosis (MS) s eqqal ach-ak wa ezzaran daɣ addinat wi madroynen d wi ijjanen awatay

source: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
reference: MS nta turhna ta yeggaten iɣef, iɣesan dd iẓerwan n awadem ar yewweḍ tiṭṭawin nit.
hypothesis: MS taqqal aɣašad ijjan fal sistem wan nervous central, eqqalan eɣaf, medulla tan n achareɣa d optic nerve

source: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
reference: Agamay usnan isken-d, tuntawin rnint ugarent dag PS miden.
hypothesis: Farak ijraw as tiw-at ten illan ti tikma sin i MS fal tiw-at ten

source: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
reference: Imerrawen dubin ad nhaḍen war ihussay full-sen miɣ full arra kud sidwellen anubi.
hypothesis: Amidiwan addoben ad afhan as war eqqal a fal aharoj nasan meɣ fal aharoj n ilyadan nasan as ijjan i tarwa

source: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
reference: Imerrawen wiɣ dubin ad aktun kud ran ad sedwellen inuba.
hypothesis: Imazlayan win addoben ad afhan ad ijjichan ad ikfan tiɣiswen i tarwa nasan

source: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
reference: As iga asedwel, imerrawen n anubi wi n tidet igdal-asen ak haret full anubi, ad yekk imerrawen wi haḍnin.
hypothesis: Daɣ adakal, imaɣran wi n tamudre ikfa tanaya tan nasnat fal addinat iyyad ad aqqilan imaɣran n ilyadan

source: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
reference: Iswi wa meqqaren n musnet anta ad sanen mamek amadal igal s tamella n tarayt n musnet. Tarayt taɣ tilil miden wi n musnet.
hypothesis: Assahat ən tənumaq taqal ayknan ye afanaz ən tamkare ən aduniyat as alməɣnat ən tənumaq. Tamkare ten, dǎɣ tidit, tagan ajotnen umaɣ ən tənumaq.

source: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
reference: Anta warǧi ɣas-nnit, asekyed anta akayad iyen kanen-t full ad sugeggen iyet miɣ ugar n turdiyin, ad sestennen, titar, ad acwaḍen cund wa tagen dag musnet.
hypothesis: War eqqel ɣas, amedran, d amiyiz eqqal amiyiz eqqal a exdam i ad ikfa asuj iyyan meɣ ajjotnen n mirda tan, asistan, d akayad eqqal achareɣa n farak wan science

source: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
reference: Imusnawen n agama d wi n lfalsafa gan musnet--nsen full idrisen irun, dag tizzar, win n Bible s latin.
hypothesis: Inasjafar win ahinzazaɣ d filozof tan ijjan ijjit nasan fal ikitban win aru tolas hullan fal alkitab wan Latin

source: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
reference: Ihǎnayan n-Aristot ǎmossan a-itiwaqbalan fal awa ǎqqǎlan isistanan fuk fal alçim, haddid musnat tan tiwittawen.
hypothesis: Iddikud tan win Aristotle fal majal tan fuk n science ahan psychology

source: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
reference: As teqqel musnet ta n Lyunan s deffer, Ikalen wi n afella grawen iman-nsen tebba-sen musnet d iki wa n lfalsafa.
hypothesis: Alwaq wa id musnat n Greek t ikna afanaz, alɣalim tan win ikufar ijjan iman nasan ijjit n filozofi tan Greek d science

source: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
reference: Acalay ggent acwaden-ten dag musnet n kaya n tafekka n awadem, antani ilan full asaɣet tan byulogiya.
hypothesis: Iddikud tan ajjotnen iknanen daɣ physiology d alxal alwaq iyyan ijjan fal iban afor n endogenous cycles d ijji nasan s biological clock tan

source: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
reference: Acala n imir wi war nettara full idracen wi n tiniri, full haraten n imudiren, gan-asen ilkaḍen cung backeria, ickan, axuten.
hypothesis: Timəɣwen ən alwaq, winan eqel ayknan asisiwi ən təɣirwen ən alwaq ən edaj, aqalan atiwəjrawan fal ajət ən imudaran, atamosan baətérietan, fungi, ihishkan ad imudaran.

source: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
reference: Asaɣet tan biyoloji anta oscillators wi ilkamen ialus n imir ilelli, anta aba-has idracen wi n tiniri.
hypothesis: Timsalen tin abarkot aqqalan oscillator tan wi azilzam nen i azzaman n tikarmat n tikarmat har ajjudi daɣ iban isalan n ajjama

source: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
reference: Akayad n musnet iga Hershey d Chase, seknen-d DNA illa daɣ mantatu n awadem.
hypothesis: Iruman ən Hershey əd Chase aqalan iyan dǎɣ wi ogaran as ADN eqal harat ən génétique.

source: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
reference: Hershey d Chase Saxdemmen phage miɣ virus iyen full ad knen DNA n wiɣ dag lbaktirya.
hypothesis: Hershey d Chase axdaman phage tan meɣ virus tan i asissiki n DNA nasan daɣ bacterium

source: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
reference: Knan sin ikayaden, iyen ADN wa n pharge d fusfur ta haḍet pritin wa n pharge d sulfur n afa.
hypothesis: Ijjan amiyiz n issin ijjan DNA daɣ phage s phosphorus n radioactive meɣ protein wan phage s sulfur wan radioactive

source: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
reference: Abeddel yeddubi ad yell haret n tigawin war ulin ilmend n tawsit n ameskel, tixutert n tafult n ADN iɣhan, kud isan wi iɣhan antani isan wi n twekki.
hypothesis: Imutiyan adoben agaraw ən ajotnen ijitan abdanen dǎɣ asikin ən əmik wan imutiyan, ən tənna ən əšiɣil ən harat ən génétique atiwəjanen əd as əelluletan atiwəjanen aqalan əelluletan ən tabarat tan germ.

source: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
reference: Ɣas ameskel neɣ abeddel dag isan twekki dubin ad altaɣen inuba. Ameskel dag ideg wa haḍen yeddub ad yenɣ isan wiɣ miɣ ad yeǧ saratan.
hypothesis: Imuttiyan daɣ izirwan win germ line ɣas addobat nat ad awikkal nat i warraw, as ijja awen imuttiyan daɣ ihandagan iyyad addoben ad ijjichan tamattant n izirwan meɣ cancer

source: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
reference: Atireggac dag tiniri yettawiy-d ddinet wi irhan tiniri full inin ad hanyen icken d axuten i yellan diɣ.
hypothesis: Turisme wan ahinzazaɣ eqqal a ijraw addinat wi ijjan imuɣ i ihandagan n ahinzazaɣ i ad ijjichan ihanan eha ahinzazaɣ d arizzej

source: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
reference: Llan iweẓlan wi kanen diɣ cund agadel n awuten n tiniri miɣ wi n aman, asiwer, acaweḍ n igḍaḍ, atireggac dag igelmam, akayad n isalen full tameddurt n imudiren.
hypothesis: Almital tan n alxidmaten daɣ edag eha tamattant, asiwad, asukni, akayad n imudaran d asiwad n parks d teɣare n isalan fal ecosystem

source: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
reference: Cund, asukel, asiwer, alamad wan Organgatuangs dag Borneo.
hypothesis: Almital eqqal asidu, afut d teɣare n organgatuang tan daɣ Borneo

source: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
reference: Ak tufat, aK awadem ad ikel s akal-nit ad yak akal wa haden s tureft, dag abaraq ad imhay anta d ddinet wiyaḍ akkal-d s ikalen wiyen usi-n berri akal waɣ.
hypothesis: Harwa azzaman, addinat ijjan tiɣarmaten ti madroynen daɣ akal s auto tan i ad ehan daɣ alxidmat nasan tolas ijjan addinat iyyad s alxidmat nasan eqqal edag s ijjitnen

source: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
reference: Dag tigawin tiɣ n asiweḍ, ddinet mdan cund inin, qqanen berrin anagraw iyen n asiweḍ cund lkarhabat d tureft.
hypothesis: Daɣ tasassaɣrawt ten n isuj n isuj fuk daɣ immik iyyan id sistem n isuj ijjan fal imuttiyan n addinat

source: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
reference: Misnet teskan-d, tadamsa taɣ n lkarbun tga ameskel hullan dag biosphere full ideg wa yugdan, anta imestan amahaẓ n ddinet full lmaryun n iwetyan.
hypothesis: Timusnawen indišadan amarad as taməte ten maqarat ən karbone təjrawat biosphère daɣ iyat ən təməddurten ənes atiwəjanen taməte ən adinat dǎɣ assin milliontan ən elan.

source: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
reference: Ak iyen icirek dag aɣrem dag asiweḍ. AK war iri anagra waɣ n asiweḍ.
hypothesis: Addinat fuk ijjan tamudre nasan daɣ tamazduq tolas axdaman s sistem tan n transport

source: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
reference: Dag ikalen win igudin war tsaled i inaw inin taɣara n aman war tehhusay miɣ abaraqa inḍaw.
hypothesis: Daɣ addawla tan ti s ijja efes war t isalan i majrad n ich-ikilan chund win fal alɣalim n aman meɣ idayan n idwalan

source: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
reference: Ma full anagraw n asiweḍ war igudi, ma full abada ixrak? Imusnawen n alalen asiweḍ war ddubin ? miɣ haret iyen a yegrawen?
hypothesis: Awa s iknan sistem tan win isasawad ijjanen majrad tan šund win, awa s iknan fal as war n oɣed har ajjudi?

source: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
reference: Traffic Flow anta musnet ta itakyaden tigaw n wi isaglen d tikli n tureft ǧir sin idgen d tigawin ilan ǧir-isen.
hypothesis: Traffic Flow eqqal teɣare n tamatikwayt n imuttiyan d isuj jir issin titbaqqa d alxidmaten id wi s itaj nen

source: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
reference: Tikerẓi n amellil, akayad n tikli n tureffin isuheḍ full ini war teddubi ad tesned kud amadem wa yessegli isxa tamiḍi full tamiḍi.
hypothesis: Awen, teɣare n tamatikwayt n imuttiyan t assohat fal as alxal wan awikkal war addobat a eɣna s tumast n 100 n temedyan

source: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
reference: Dag tidawit, midden wi yesseglen llan tiyati, saglen sullan, awa yessilcel tikli n turafa sullan, teddubit a tessekned s musnet n asiḍen.
hypothesis: A hin, imuzaran aqqalan aqqalnen aqqalnen daɣ edag n alɣalim; awen, isalan n alɣalim ilan alɣalim n alɣalim tolas addobat nat ad aqqilan a eqqalan aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqalnen aqqal

source: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
reference: Full inin ad seknen tikli illan diɣ abaraqa knan kraḍ n assaɣen : 1) Tikli, 2) asget, 3) Tazla dag tikli.
hypothesis: I ad ikna iddikud n tamatikwayt n imuttiyan, tartit tan tijat jir sammos samalan wi maqqornen: (1) tamatikwayt, (2) iddikud d (3) alwaq

source: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
reference: Aseɣ wiɣ itilal full asuɣen d amuken n iweẓlan n abaraq.
hypothesis: Tamatikwayt ten tawanfa daɣ aɣanni, edey d alxidmat n isuj win abara

source: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
reference: Ican antani axuten wi izaren dag aferfer, adubi n tikli incil-asen ad arwlen, ad awyen titetti d tmidiyin yulaɣen.
hypothesis: Imazalan wi azaran adoben adilkaman. Təmusne nasan ən afarag taganen-as aditiwaɣrawan ad ajaraw ən ihuk ad imudaran ogdahan.

source: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
reference: Haraten n ican ddubin ad tellen afriwen-nsen full tafekka-nsen.
hypothesis: Ijjit n imudaran ilan alfayda n as addobat nat ad ardan ijjit nasan s afalla n taɣissa

source: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
reference: Waɣ ikfa-sen idgan wi induknin agetten i axutten ad ffren.
hypothesis: Awen ihak edag maqqoran n idagan madroynen i ad effan daɣ imudaran

source: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
reference: Acel waɣ, ɣas ican n tinin d ican n mayu raddubi ad tellen ifrawen-nsen.
hypothesis: Iddik tan wi war addoben ad arduwan iɣalayan nasan aqqalan dragon flies d mayflies

source: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
reference: Agim n iwetyan ar deffer, ales iyen isem-nit Aristarchus ina anagraw n tafuk itaǧen full tafuk.
hypothesis: Iwityan wi azzarnen, awadim s isim net Aristarchus allaɣat as Solar System izzayat fal tafukt

source: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
reference: Haret n ddinet aktan tidet a yenna beccan wiyeḍ akten warǧi tidet awa yenna. Full anagraw n tafuk igal full amadal,( akked itran wiyeḍ).
hypothesis: Addinat iyad aniyat as ila tidit mašan adinat ajotnen amosan anilkamnen; as əmik wan tafuk azagar fal akal, atamosan tafuk (ad haretan iyad).

source: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
reference: Waɣ tenned tidet, full ini war tsaled kud amadal igal, tidet miɣ?
hypothesis: Awen olahan, falas akal war eqqal as eqqal a ehan, eqqal?

source: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
reference: Anǧi wa n Amazon anta hegaret meqqar wan sin dag amadal.yettawiy 8 ṭam n awa ttawyen inǧa wiyeḍ dag aman.
hypothesis: Amazonas eqal was assin dǎɣ təzune əd wa ogaran təmɣire dǎɣ akal. Ənta əktab hulen 8 n azaman ogaran təmɣire ən second river.

source: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
reference: Anǧi wan Amazon anta wa meqqaren ǧir inǧan n amadal, anta illa sḍis n miles daɣ imir iyen.
hypothesis: Amazonas eqqal deɣ ehan wa ojjaran fal akal, alwaqqan iyyad eqqal a ojjaran s 6 mil

source: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
reference: Snatet tmearwin 20 ful timiḍi n aman win amaḍal wa-d-iffalen iɣezran d yenɣel daɣ iǧiriw yeffal-d Amazon.
hypothesis: 20 n temede n aman wi id izjarnen s aman n amadal daɣ aman eqqal Amazon

source: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
reference: Iɣazzer wa meqquren daɣ Amazon ila 6,387 n Km( 3,980 miles). Yessidaw aman n iɣazeren ɣared-nsen.
hypothesis: Amazonas wa maqqoran eqqal 6 387 n kilometir tan eɣna aman n timizdaɣ ti maqqornen

source: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
reference: Kunta amukken n pyramid s ikkadiwen yelkam har ticrayet n tamnukla ta trut, pyramid win Giza war ifniẓ taceǧrit-nnit d ammek ulaɣen wa-s-yedday.
hypothesis: Harwa təmuqunt ən piramidetan ən təɣirwen təwaɣrət har samando ən anməɣrəm wan tədawt, piramidetan ən Gizeh winan eqel harkuk atiwaɣran dǎɣ təzune əd təmusnawen ən təmuqunt nasan.

source: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
reference: Egyptians wi iruwnin n tamnukla ta teynayet ekkunen daɣ takkassit n wi-hasen-yezzarnin, wa-s-kallad tella a yuǧaren aǧiw n awatay.
hypothesis: Masar tan win aru ijjan alisteɣmar i ikayadan win aru, wi ilanen iwityan hullan daɣ awatay

source: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
reference: Midden win aɣrem wan Vatican ugdan d 800 n awadem. Yeqqal akkal wan ntukken hullan ilulleten daɣ amaḍal d akkal wa-daɣ efnaẓen midden hullan.
hypothesis: Vatican City t amos addawla ta maqqorat n alistexlal daɣ alɣalim tolas addawla ta ilan ichaɣib wa andarran

source: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
reference: Aɣrem wan Vatican issaxdam tawalt tan Italian daɣ tssertit-nit d anmiǧrah wan dimaɣ.
hypothesis: Vatican City t exdam tangalt daɣ achareɣa net d majrad net wan alxakum

source: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
reference: Italian, daɣ teqqal tawalt tan hak acel ta saxdamen a-yeǧin daɣ midden wi iwiẓlatnin daɣ tamnukla, daɣ elwaq wad-saxdamen Latin daɣ tidfaṣkawin tin eddin.
hypothesis: Italian eqqal awal n alwaq fuk s axdam addinat wi ajjotnen daɣ alxidmat daɣ addawla as ijja awen Latin eqqal awal n alwaq iyyan daɣ alxidmaten n addin

source: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
reference: Imezzaɣ win Vatican emdan emussen Roman Catholic.
hypothesis: Addinat fuk n Vatican City aqqalan Roman Catholic

source: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
reference: Kallad essanen eddunet ful tayunin tin chemical tin basic cund uraɣ d aẓref d taẓuli men iwetyan iruwnin, as teddubid aten-teǧrawed daɣ tiniri s udem-nsen wa yezzaren d yeẓewet a ten-teǧrawed s allalen wi yruwnin.
hypothesis: Addinat ilan musnat fal haratan wi maqarnen ən chimique sund aɣalam, azruf ad arami ɣur azaman, falas kul aqalan adoben atiwagrawan dǎɣ təbiɗawen dǎɣ əmik ənes əd aqalan oɣadnen ye aśuhu dər iritan wi azarnen.

source: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
reference: Aristotle, philosopher, iǧa turda as haraten emdan eknan daɣ tasertit n tayunt miɣ a-yuǧaren ekkuẓet tayunin. Emusen amaḍal d aman d aḍu d timsi.
hypothesis: Aristote, filozof, asissiki as haratan kul aqalan aygan dǎɣ iyan meɣ ajotnen ən akatan win akatan: akal, aman, adu ad aman.

source: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
reference: Awaɣ yulah d ekkuẓ elxalen win haraten( daɣ asilkum iyen) yeqqur, yebdaǧ, gas d ahu hullan yurda as eqqalen kayaten wiyuḍ ful ad eknin awa nhannay.
hypothesis: Awen eqqal chund alɣalim tan win akkoz n harat (daɣ ach-ak iyyan): solid, liquid, gas d plasma kuddeɣ as ijja majrad n as amuttiyan s isuj eynaynen i ad aqqilan awa n akayad

source: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
reference: Alloys mukannin hullan daɣ asserti n metals essin miɣ a t-ugaren. War hin-tetewed as lant a-yeǧin daɣ tayuni daɣ periodic table.
hypothesis: Aloi tan aqqalan iddikud n issin meɣ haratan ajjotnen n metalen.

source: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
reference: Tayunin cund calcium d potassium ǧan-ten daɣ metals.hullan, illi daaɣ metals cund aẓref d oraɣ.
hypothesis: Element tan chund calcium d potassium aqqalan metal tan.

source: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
reference: Teddubid daɣ ad tekreced alloys ti hant tayunin tintuknin ti wer-nmus metals cund carbon.
hypothesis: Addobat deɣ ad ilaɣat aloi tan ahanen iddikud n haratan war n aqqel metal chund carbon

source: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
reference: Awa yhan amaḍal imda ikna daɣ hareten. Hakk haret ikna daɣ tiffulin ti-ntuknin ti-s-itiwenna atoms.
hypothesis: Haratan kul dǎɣ aduniyat aqalan aygan dǎɣ harat. harat kul eqalan aygan dǎɣ haratan ogaran təmɣire sitawǎn atometan.

source: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
reference: Atoms saǧrawen takkunt har taǧacnet aylan trillions d-esnet daɣ alwaq wad-tecray tawinest tadaɣ.
hypothesis: Atometan aqalnen hulen ogaran as trilliontan ənes adobatnen adilkamnen dǎɣ alwaq dǎɣ samando ən tənna ten.

source: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
reference: S ammek waɣ, aɣanib kallad imus amidi ulaɣen n a-yeǧin daɣ midden as d-iǧmeḍ.
hypothesis: Daɣ awen, pencil eqqal amidi olaɣan i addinat ajjotnen alwaq wa id izjar

source: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
reference: A yessarhanen, daɣ ideg wadaɣ d-ecraynen ammeken win akatab aynaynin, aɣanib yezzizubet ar status d asexdem ifnaẓen.
hypothesis: Awen eqqal a ohar nen fal as imutiyan n akatab eynayan izjaran, fal as eɣaf war eqqel a oharnen tolas war eqqel a oharnen

source: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
reference: Dimaɣ midden katraben tirawin s amatuǧ wan computer, war tahaẓin abadah asamsad-n-aɣanib.
hypothesis: Addinat har ajjudi iktab nat isalan fal computer screen tan war n ila alwaq iyyan i ad ijjuch nat i tasassaɣrawt

source: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
reference: War neddubet ɣas har-nessesten ful awa-s-yeddubet ad umas keyboard as d-icray haret iyen haḍen.
hypothesis: Addobat awadim ad asissiki awa eqqalan keyboard alwaq wa id harat eynayan id izjar

source: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
reference: Asselfeɣ-n-tuẓanet itaǧ ful principle as itawi energy ful ad ikenn nucleus s a-yeǧin daɣ protons d neutrons.
hypothesis: Bomber tan n fission axdam fal mirda n as ilzam enerji i asidu n nucleus id proton tan d neutron tan ajjotnen

source: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
reference: Cund ad enteked tureft ta-teẓayet ful tatakurt. Ad tuẓaned nucleus amir wa haḍen yessdarfat daaɣ haret daɣ energy tadaɣ.
hypothesis: Eqqal chund as eɣeš karret tan tijjit n achrut n achrut n nucleus tolas izjar id enerji

source: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
reference: Haret daɣ atoms llan nuclei war-entamnin, awa issaken as inahil ad erẓin s tiwit teṣṣuhit miɣ war teṣṣuhet.
hypothesis: Atometan iyad ilanat nukléi tan war n oɣed awen amos as taqqal tamatikwayt n asuj fal as war ilen assahat meɣ war ilen assahat

source: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
reference: Amaḍal wan iwar yekna daɣ ikadiwen d idahi. Tasutalt tan berra itiwennas crust.
hypothesis: Taɣelit tan tafuk taqal aygan ən təɣiswen əd tazoli.Tafuk tan ogaran ən tafuk taqal asitawana tazoli.

source: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
reference: Crust tellat aylan 70km daɣ aɣil wa yuhaẓen d 100km daɣ aɣil wa aɣil wa yuǧaǧen.
hypothesis: Eɣaf eqqal a ojjar 70 n kilometir daɣ achrut wa ezzaran d 100 n kilometir daɣ achrut wa ezzaran

source: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
reference: Iga isaddiden daw Maria, ihuharen daɣ ikallen eṭkalnin.
hypothesis: Eqqal a ogaran tizzarat daɣ maria tolas ojjaran daɣ idagan win alɣălim

source: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
reference: Iddubet as illi uǧar daɣ maria daɣ aɣil wa uhaẓen ful-inin crust tisadidet. Yeqqar haret nehilen ad awan lava afella n akal.
hypothesis: Addobat ad eqqil maria ajjotnen daɣ achrut n edes fal as crust eqqal a ojjaran fal as lava taqqal a ojjaran fal arori

source: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
reference: Turdawin tin a-ihan-ammas ebdadnet hullan ful umuɣ n awa yessdawen midden d awa-ten-d-iǧabbaden.
hypothesis: Tiɣir tin ihishkan ijjan fal ajaraw n awa ijjan addinat tiqqimen meɣ ijjan fal as

source: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
reference: Turdawin tidaɣ ǧannint as midden llan haraten d/miɣ n awa-ran wa-yhan ammas-nsen har ewwaḍen iwetyan win imawaḍen.
hypothesis: Tiɣir tin saknen as addinat ilanat ihzawan d / meɣ derhan iyyad s eqqal nat daɣ iman nasan alwaq wa id amutayan s tamudre n awadim

source: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
reference: Turdawin tiyaɣ tassenent tumast n midden wiyuḍ, isdiɣhalten haraten wi taǧnin d mamusen hareten win hassen ittilalalen ful ad eǧin haraten d war taǧin haraten wiyuḍ daɣ awa-han.
hypothesis: Təmusnawen ten aqalan atamosan awa itaj fal adinat iyad ye assuhu ən haratan wi əganen əd awa dǎɣ haratan ən təmotayen nasan itaganen assuhu meɣ war assuhu ən haratan iyad.

source: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
reference: Snatet turdawin ti-tiwazzayen enta as turda tan Hiarchy n tawssarit tan Maslaw d turda tan Factor wan essin tan Hertzberg.
hypothesis: Tənaten ən təzunawen assin aqalnen atiwazayan aqalan təmusne tan Maslow tan hiérarchie ən haditan əd təmusne tan Hertzberg ən əsin haratan.

source: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
reference: Daɣ temda n tenna, eddubin ad ecrayen essin n iǧiten as yessenta anamhal daɣ amhal n inmeɣuten-nnit iruwnin. Iyen daɣ tilitin immaɣ ad yeqqim" iyen daɣ midden" miɣ (tilyaḍin).
hypothesis: Daɣ majrad, alxal n issin addobat ad eqqil a eqqalan amădal n manajăyen i awătayăn nasan win aru.

source: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
reference: Waɣ analway iẓewet ful-as ad iṭef tinaḍin war itiwazzayen, iyad iǧ tinaḍin tin assimɣar, iyad yeǧ atuǧ n haraten ,iyad ikf iweẓlaɣn d ad ageẓ midden wi ssanin elxedmet.
hypothesis: Ichikil wen n manager ila anmizlayan i ad ijja majrad tan war n ikf-an addinat, ad ikf achareɣa tan n achareɣa tan, ad ikf achareɣa tan n alxidmat, ad ikf achareɣa tan n addinat

source: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
reference: Daɣ ticrayet ta haḍet n tili, awadm itaqqel ag-adem iẓewet ati-tezziyed d yufray as iwarti ad issemeskel aw-s-kallad texdam tadukkilt d at-issuɣel i-nnit.
hypothesis: Daɣ samando n spectrum, iyyan eqqal awadim war n ijji s addobat ad abarraz haratan fuk n taqqimt tolas eqqil n iman net

source: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
reference: Dat hakk hqret, analway enta a ywar , s ticrayet, tarna miɣ titwarna n tadukkilt.
hypothesis: Daɣ samando, awadim wa ezzaran eqqal a fal ittusan timɣutar d afanaz net

source: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
reference: Iǧiten cund wiyaɣ taǧen abadah iɣɣah ǧir analway d awa yeqqim n taddukilt.
hypothesis: Alxal wen alwaqqan iyyad eway id tišijrit jir awadim wan amădal d addinat wi yadnen n taqqimt

source: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
reference: Tiddukilin tin turda ulahent d tidukkilin tin-agna daɣ tisaraḍ n azemmezzi, buccan emmiẓlayent daɣ haraten wi maḍruynin.
hypothesis: Timizdaɣ tin eqqalnen aqqal nat iddikud n alɣalim chund timizdaɣ tin alɣalim mucham illanat anmizlayan

source: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
reference: Kel-taddukkilt n turda emmusen abadah tatbaqqit n amheyu n taddukkilt tan taɣessa dimaɣ.
hypothesis: Imidiwan win timizdaɣ n virtual alwaq iyyan aqqalan edag n aharoj i taqqimt n iman nasan

source: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
reference: Ugaren tidukkilin tin tillawt daɣ tilulla ful-innin taddukilt-nsen teddubet ad temheyet daɣ elwaqqen amiẓlaynin ti-s-yeddubet as war teddubet local management a ten-teǧrah.
hypothesis: Alwaqqan iyyad ilan alistexlal hullan fal addinat win taqqimt tan tin alasal fal as taqqimen nasan addobat nat ad azin daɣ time zones ajjotnen s addobat nat ad war afaham nat tanaya tan n akal

source: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
reference: Ad tili " tadukkilt war-nhanbay" tan tidet( Larson d LaFasto, 1989, p109)yeqqal daaɣ amukken n taddukkilt tan-turda ɣas-nnit.
hypothesis: Edag wan timizdaɣ n tiditt war n ila akayad (Larson d LaFasto, 1989, p109) eqqal har ajjudi achrut n timizdaɣ n tiditt

source: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
reference: "Tadukkilt ta war-nhannay" enta as tadukkilt n alaway wa-s-iwar hakk aɣil d-s ahas-ilkam. Tadukkilt ta war-nhannay taǧet timmal n hakk aɣil.
hypothesis: "Taqqimt ta war n ila akayad" eqqal taqqimt n awadim s alxakum n addinat fuk. Taqqimt ta war n ila akayad eqqal almaɣna i addinat fuk

source: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
reference: Ma fel tasaq miɣ tasadest terha ad taki semek irhan Aleq ceǧrin yemuken n Tasadest n teɣari ?haret deɣ itusen nit asines n uǧrihen n Alamad wa idasen ,ideg wan Aseweǧ nta as Amuken d acecri.
hypothesis: Awa fal taqqimt ad taghil ad taghil tamatikwayt tazzarat n asinti n taqqimt n teɣare? ittus iyyan i asinti n isim tan n teɣare n taqqimt daɣ alxidmat amos amutti

source: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
reference: As neswaǧa izezǧar wi nella ɣred wi nella semek iknan deɣ tenmehliwin ti aweẓletnin aninhi n tasadest wer nezey ,adubet ad iseken Acecri d amuken ulaɣen.
hypothesis: Alwaq wa id isuj fuk ilanen axadam s assahat daɣ functional departments n taggayt, tamatikwayt d ta-ite addobat nat ad ikrichan

source: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
reference: Awa ded izǧaren awind ,adubet ad itweǧ aweẓlu n Tasadest ,nadiw har nernu takarist d akay ilan amek ded iknan.
hypothesis: Dǎɣ alkum, tamatikwayt ən tartit ta taganen dǎɣ tartit fal adakal ən aśuhu adobat adiqil aygan dǎɣ tamatikwayt ta aynayat ən tamusne fal asukni ən aniyat ən amaššaɣalan.

source: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
reference: Dat ad teqel tasadedt aded iknan ,iwar temukla aded teken agna wan aseneheǧ siweḍ fel awin musnet ta tesertayet d Aselmad wa idasen.
hypothesis: Dat addikud adobat ad eqqil amasuɣal, tamudre n amass ilzam ad eɣna agna n amasuɣal hak id musnat tan tazunt d teɣare n taggayt

source: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
reference: Angel (2006), isaǧrahed tabaret tan Continuum tamust Tabaret titweǧit i tellilt i tesesaharin yaǧaḍ n eswir n ǧeneǧn awa mukenan.
hypothesis: Angel (2006), isissəkna tamatikwayt tan Continuum chund ta-ite ijjanen i alxidmat i taggayen i ag-az n alxidmat

source: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
reference: Imil n selan win n aẓaren wi amramernin amusen adalil i tabaret tan akayad i umeɣ deɣ uǧrih fel awin itikraẓed acrut wan umeɣ itaǧi ayeknan muken hullan.
hypothesis: Isalan win neurobiology ikfanat asidutti n physical i majrad n mirda i farak n musnat. Isalan win ijjan edag n farak eqqalan a ojjaran

source: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
reference: Tasaq ǧir musnet n turhenawin tin akelkel d iǧiten n awadem alilnet i kel musnet deɣ umaɣen nasen.
hypothesis: Anmizlay jir brain pathology d alxal eqqal alxidmat n sicentist tan daɣ farak nasan

source: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
reference: Atiwasen deɣ Alweqen ukaynin hulan as ameken aǧutnin n aɣacad n akelkel d tewit d baxasen d turhenawin ti teǧacnin iɣef wer nfinet timuǧatin n awadem tirunated daɣ asemeti deɣ weẓlan n teyeti.
hypothesis: Eqqal harat issanan daɣ azzaman eynayan as ich-ikilan n iɣasan, traumas, lesions d tumors iknan tinfa fal alxal tolas iknan imutiyan daɣ alxidmaten n ta-ite

source: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
reference: Ameken wi aynaynin asurhaǧen aneɣ Akayad n teɣsa n tiǧawin n akelkel d umeɣ deɣ senet as wer kala diǧa dat awa.
hypothesis: Assuhu ən təmusnawen tə aynaynen itaj-anaɣ ad akayad ən təmuqunen ad timusnawen winan atwasan dat awa.

source: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
reference: Awahret aẓimaẓeker aneɣ ayeǧin deɣ musnaten d talɣiwin ya Adey n keyaden wi haneɣ ti lalnin yuǧrih temḍunin deɣ tiyetwin naneɣ.
hypothesis: Awen ijraw-aɣ ajotnen isalan d isuj i edey n dumu tan n simulation i ad aɣ-id ifhamen tamatikwayt daɣ ta-ite

source: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
reference: Haked kud as ila ukrac n teyeti tan mukenan taǧuhi taṣuhit fel azenezgumi n musnet , akeẓu n Mukenan ikna acrut ilan atuǧ hullan deɣ musnaten win orditen ,itaweẓlat daɣ d tacni d almud d asedubi n teyeti wa adiwen d amatuǧ.
hypothesis: Harwa IA ila assəkən ən tamusne, IA eqal ašrut ən tənumaq ən ordinateur, dǎɣ tabarat ən tamusne, ad tamusne ad assəmutiy ən tamusne dǎɣ maɗinan.

source: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
reference: Umeɣ deɣ akeẓu wan mukenan amuken n mutaǧ yesemend n weẓlan wi arhanin tacni d teyeti .
hypothesis: Umaɣ fal IA itagan igitan ye assəməsədu ən haratan wi aduten ən taməɣluk.

source: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
reference: Cundten emarend uḍef d anuṭef d asenemenek d tadabit fel asuɣel fel awa arhen meǧencan d sestanen nasen ,siweḍ fel awin muwyet n atater n afus , d amesli d idem.
hypothesis: Almital tan eha awikkal, aɣanni d alwaq, assahat n ijji n alwazab i musnat d isistanan n alxidmat d musnat n akatab, awal d udim

source: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
reference: Hareten cund wi amusen tiɣer ameẓlynin ,ti abded nin fel aǧaraw n tezezǧar i tekaras n temudri tan tidet.
hypothesis: Haratan win aqqalan timizdaɣ izlayan, s afor n alxoriya i muchakil tan n tamudre tan tiditt

source: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
reference: Deɣ aǧut nnit Akeẓu n'mukenan ititweǧi deɣ degan cund Aẓemeẓeker d Asesefer d asesenǧl d Aserdusa, idey daɣ deɣ degan aǧutnin deɣ orditen ,d meclan n videoten win hanan.
hypothesis: Əmik wan IA eqal agudiyan amitkalan dǎɣ kalan ən économie, ən təmusne, ən təmusne əd tanes, sund atiwakasan dǎɣ ajotnen əmikan ən ordinateur əd əmik ən əšiɣil ən vidéo.

source: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
reference: Isikilen s kalen lan atuǧ mequren deɣ tasemhuyt n teɣri .deɣ alweqen aǧutnin ,tasuf tasalmadt agay n nalmaden nit s degan wi wer itiweḍ bus wan teɣari .
hypothesis: Ijjit n abara eqqal achrut maqqoran n taɣrimat fuk alwaq iyyan maqqar ad eqqil s ijjit n attalaba net ihandagan s war t illa tikarsay n bus

source: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
reference: Teknelogy sansed tizezǧar semek wan aseǧbar n sikilen .adubin nalmaden ahin akyeden allen hareten deɣ wi arunin deɣ Asatwar miɣ ass ideg n manan miɣ asǧed i sehska wi ahusketnin deɣ alweq wad hen ihenseɣri.
hypothesis: Təmusne tagan alɣisab fal iji ən təjriten ən təɣirwen. Aləmad adoben akayad ən haratan ən musée, adobat adagu ən aquarium, meɣ adobat ad assəməsəd ən tamusne tahat as təla.

source: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
reference: Temus tihra n azaǧur tayeti tulaɣet yezenezǧumi deɣ tesikkelt d asesiher n tirmitin d tesemha ti ded malanin .
hypothesis: Asidu n abara n teɣare daɣ almaɣna eqqal immik olaɣan i ad akayad fal abara d asidu n musnat id timusnawen n iwityan win ušray

source: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
reference: Cund, taǧen nalmaden hak awatay deɣ tenaɣrit Bennet ,deɣ lwilaya tan Carolina n Afella amuken n adeg n web semek was awaḍen tabutut n lwilaya ,itiles daɣ amuken n adeg n web hak awatay ,mucan tigẓen imuknan wi ukeynin fel internit,yad tumas amek n tekarḍiwin .
hypothesis: Almital, daɣ awatay fuk , attalaba tan n Bennet School daɣ Carolina tan tamasna iknan sit fal tikar n State Capital, daɣ awatay fuk sit wan ehan eqqal amutay net mucham version tan win aru iknan intanet i ad aqqilan scrapbook

source: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
reference: Tisafnaɣin daɣ adubetnet ad ilalnet deɣ tadabit n nalmaden deɣ afanaɣ . Deɣ as inalmaden santin s tirmit n afanaɣ n tesafnaɣin nasen s temankayin n tawalt d aseḍni ,mucan imil n aɣref isemtetey awind ɣred nnit.
hypothesis: Blog tan addoben ad idhal nat i afanaz n akatab n attalaba. Alwaq wa id attalaba tan alwaq iyyan issinta musnat nasan n blog s grammar d alkittab n almaɣna, ehay n addinat daɣ almaɣna iyyan amuttiyan

source: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
reference: Deɣ as inalmaden tumasen aɣref wa ikanen abayak ,isanta anafnaɣ n tasefneq deɣ umeɣ yerit n asileɣ n afanaɣ yad icli i abayak .
hypothesis: Fal as attalaba tan aqqalan addinat wi ojjaran afor, bloger issinta ad ijji alxidmat net i afanaz n akatab i ad eɣbal afor

source: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
reference: Siweḍ fel awin as afanaɣ "icahacal inalmaden yad akrecen musnet s akal wa ten deɣley ɣalayen" daɣ terha n ukes n fad i aɣref wa ten ikyaden awad ɣred isawaḍ deɣ nalmaden yad aknen ukrac n teyeti atweǧrahanin (Toto,2004).
hypothesis: " Blogging " eqqal a fal tijja teɣare i ad aqqilan a fal isalan n alɣalim" almaɣna n as ilzam i asidu n alxidmat n addinat eqqal asidu n teɣare i ad aqqilan a oɣadnen tolas aqqal nen a fal isalan win teɣare (Toto, 2004)

source: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.

reference: Aseweǧ wa yulaɣen i tesafnaɣin itiwi s "ad udabin nalmaden ad safaykin bayaken , awind iǧmaḍed asurhaǧ i aseweẓli wa yulaɣen i mutaǧ win Internet,inalmaden daɣ adubin ad seknen ihanayen nasen deɣ fanaɣen n wi heḍnin , siweḍ fel awin ad aknen amumni n kayaden nasen iman nasen fel harten amiẓleynin (Oravec,2002).
hypothesis: " Alxidmat n blog tan " addobat ad ikf alxidmaten i addinat i ad aqqilan a ojjaran afanaz d achareɣa; s alxidmat n isalan win Internet, addinat addoben ad afissar nat titbaqqa nasan daɣ almaɣna n ikitban n wi yadnen hak id afissar n titbaqqa nasan fal muchakil tan iyyad" (Oravec, 2002).

source: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
reference: Ottawa nta as tebutut n akal ta teknet tihussay ,hanette sanatet tilesin hantet daɣ mesekniten n sehska d setwar wi seknanin mentatu n Canada d amarad nnit.
hypothesis: Ottawa taqqal kapital tan Canada ta taqqal a tan-ijjit tolas tila iddikud n art gallery tan d muse tan ijjan fal Canada tin aru d tin amarad

source: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.

hypothesis: Daɣ emaynag eqqal Niagara Falls tolas daɣ tamasna eqqal ehan n ahinzazaɣ war n ijji n Muskoka d s ajjama

source: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
reference: Tseɣsert n Kruger(KNP)deɣ fuy brin aɣaḍel n tafuk deɣ anahul n afara wa ful yerkeb deɣ igananaten n Mozambique deɣ atkul n tafuk, d Zimbabwe brin fuy, d agananaten n anahul nta as asif n aɣucaf.
hypothesis: Kruger National Park (KNP) eqqal daɣ tamasna n alqiblat n Afrikiya tan tamasna tolas eqqal s alxadud n Mozambique daɣ alqiblat, Zimbabwe daɣ tamasna tolas alxadud wan emaynag eqqal Crocodile River

source: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
reference: Taseɣsert termas adakuḍ 19,500 km² taẓun ful 14 ecozones amiẓlaynin, ak iyyet tasidhel tamaeddurt tamiẓlayet.
hypothesis: Park eqqal 19,500 km2 tolas izjar daɣ 14 n ecozone tan izlaynen, fuk daɣ is kala ehan tamudre n ehan

source: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
reference: Tmus iyet daɣ ideggan wi yejbadnin ti-tiwazzayen daɣ aǧus n wan Africa, teqqal daaɣ iyet daɣ ideggan axiwes ti-tiwazzaynin daɣ aǧus n Africa(SANParks).
hypothesis: Eqal iyan dǎɣ haratan wi maqornen ən Afrique tan sud əd eqalan atiwagan sund tabarat tan National Parks tan Afrique tan sud (SANParks).

source: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
reference: Cund awat-ellan ideggan naxiwes tin amaḍal n aǧus wan Africa, illi araẓam n amuken d uǧuh daɣ park.
hypothesis: Sund dǎɣ haratan kul ən Parques Nationaux ən Afrique du Sud, ilant təmotayen ən tamudre əd təmotayen ən tizarat ye parque.

source: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
reference: Yeddubet daaɣ ad umas haret-enfanin as d teǧenced Wild Card, wa yzuǧǧuhen daɣ ifergan wiyuḍ daɣ Africa tan aǧus miɣ daɣ ifergan n akkal wan aǧus wan Africa emdan.
hypothesis: Adobat deɣ ad eqqal a ojjaran i awadim ad iznu Wild Card, s itaj in s park tan n addawla tan n Afrikiya tan tamasna meɣ National Park tan n Afrikiya tan tamasna

source: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
reference: Islan tan Hong Kong tekfa akal wan Hong Kong isem-nnit, yeqqal daaɣ ideg wa-ran hullan imaǧaren .
hypothesis: Island tan Hong Kong ikf-an isim net akal wan Hong Kong tolas eqqal edag s ijjan imuzaran ajjotnen as eqqal titbaqqet

source: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
reference: Asihar n tiɣahmin ti iknanin tasariṭ tan ellahassin Hong Kong kallad essisalahent d taɣessa inihalnin ilmaεnin immun-d as t-llan aman n win ihend-aman wan Victoria.
hypothesis: Tiɣarmaten ti s itawan haratan win Hong Kong aqqalan chund tabla n bar tan ti s- itawan aman n Victoria Harbour

source: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
reference: Ful ad tenhayed a-yhussiyen daɣ Hong Kong, ezǧar Island, tekked iddis n aǧilal n aman win Kowloon udem-s-udem.
hypothesis: I ad ijjich akayad wa olaɣan n Hong Kong, itawayan daɣ akal tolas eway s Kowloon waterfront

source: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
reference: Awa yuǧaren daɣ asissalaɣ n tiɣahmin daɣ island tan Honk kong iga hullan ful ikallen amukassnin daɣ aǧilal n iɣazar wan afella.
hypothesis: Ijjit n efes n iɣirman n Hong Kong Island eqqal fal akal eɣna s alxoriya n amadal

source: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
reference: Enta as ideg wa ǧan icenǧa win British i-nsen full-awin as temmaɣem i awa-itbaten uǧuh n akal iruwen, enta as tatbaqqit ta tulaɣet ulah tasentut.
hypothesis: A wen eqqal edag wa s ikfa kel Britania tan daɣ akal nasan tolas a fal arhaɣ nat isalan n alisteɣmar n akal wan kel koloni tan awen eqqal edag olaɣan i ad issintan

source: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
reference: Sundarbans temus taddukkilt ta-meqquret n ickan win belt deɣ amaḍal, iweḍ 80km( 50 mi) deɣ ḍerat n akkal wan Bangladeshi d india ser aǧilal.
hypothesis: Sundarbans eqqal tasassaɣrawt ta maqqorat n mangrove daɣ alɣalim, t anilkamat 80 km (50 mi) s akal wan Bangladesh d India daɣ akal wan akarach

source: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
reference: UNISCO iǧa Sundarbanes iyen deɣ idegan win takkassit tan amaḍal. Taẓunt tan tiramhitin ta-hat akkal wan India itiwennas Sundarbans National Park.
hypothesis: Sundarbans eqal aygan dǎɣ UNESCO dǎɣ amas ən alɣibadat ən aduniyat.Tiyit ən ehan dǎɣ akal wan Inde eqal asitawana Sundarbans National Park.

source: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
reference: Tiremhitin waǧiɣ ɣas iǧelmamen win mangrove, telat daaɣ haret deɣ midden wi-d-iqqimnin daɣ tiramhatin ti-ṣuhatnin tis-kallad warent tatakurt tan Gangetic.
hypothesis: Ihishkan win war aqqelnen ɣas ihishkan n mangrove kuddeɣ as ahan ti ijjit n ijjit n ihishkan win assahat wi ijjan alɣalim wan Gangetic

source: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
reference: Sundarbans tellat aylan 3,850km², daɣ ideg wa ywar tafult-tan-kraḍ ideggan n aman/ marsh areas.
hypothesis: Sundarbans ehan 3,850 km2, daɣ awen ilan 1/3 n edag wan aman/mard

source: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
reference: Men awatay wan 1966, Sundarsban teqqal tamagaẓt n tamuddrit tan tiniri, urdan as ellanet 400 n imayassen imnukalen win Bangald aylan 30,000 n icenkeḍen wi han titbaqqa daɣ akal windaɣ.
hypothesis: Sundarbans eqqal edag n tamudre n ahinzuj ɣur awatay wan 1966 tolas ijja addabara as amarad illan 400 tiger tan win Bengal d ijjit n 30,000 n tazoli tan n tazoli daɣ edag wen

source: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
reference: Izazǧer Bus ihendeg n tibeddi ǧir iɣerman ( ful iɣazar) , deɣ acel imda, amagal n awin a-yeǧin desnet, hullan ti kkanin ataram d Jakar/Bumthang tezǧer ful 06:30 d 07:30.
hypothesis: Bus tan izjaran s sit tan n bus tan win jir distrit tan (as taj tammilt n achal) daɣ alwaq fuk n achal kuddeɣ as ijjit nasan hullan s alqiblat d Jakar/Bumthang izjaran jir 06:30 d 07:30.

source: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
reference: Kud Buses win ǧir-iɣerman daɣ amiren ǧutnin eḍnant hullan, uffa ad teǧenced ticket dat assikel s haret n icilan.
hypothesis: Fal as bus tan win jir distrit tan ahanen harkuk, eqqal almaɣna n ad iznu tikarmat i alwaq iyyan

source: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
reference: A yeǧin daɣ iɣerman ixdam-tenet coaster Buses tintuknin, ulaɣnet d eṣuhinet.
hypothesis: Ijjit n iɣirman tan ijjan s Japanese Coaster Bus tan madroynen, wi ojjaran tolas ojjaran

source: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
reference: Tureffin n taxi uharnin eqqalnet allal yermaḍen , issunfassen i assikel berin ideggan nnihraǧnin cund Paro( Nu150) d Punakha(Nu200).
hypothesis: Taksi tan wi azunnen aqqalan abara n alham d ahinzazaɣ i ijjuch n ihandagan wi edes n akal chund Paro (Nu 150) d Punakha (Nu 200).

source: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
reference: Tayawent tan aɣacer wan oyabok, tamust tasawent takireyrayet, iɣacer wad n oyabok usaɣ taɣremt tan oyabok deɣ brazil d giana tan france.
hypothesis: Ehan wan Oyapock eqqal ehan n tasassaɣrawt n tasassaɣrawt. Ehan wan Oyapock ehay id tiɣarmaten tin Oiapoque daɣ Brazil d Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock daɣ French Guiana

source: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
reference: Iweḍ aḍkul n hanan 83 atamet temerwin d karaḍ n meter d teceǧret nasen 378 n meter karaḍt temaḍ d asayet temerwin d atam, hanten daɣ asin berdan awaḍnin s tecuhert nasen 3.50 karḍ d semus metaren.
hypothesis: Tiɣawăyen tin issin tijja s 83 n metir, 378 n metir d tijjit n issin n tiɣawăyen n 3.50 n metir

source: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
reference: Ugec daw tasawent 15 maraw metren d semus, imnda adey nit deɣ awatay wan asin afḍen d maraw d eyen 2011, wer amira yesesiki n haraten har mares 2017.
hypothesis: Edag eqal ayknan dǎɣ août 2011, winan eqal aywar ye alməɣna har mars 2017.

source: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
reference: Tasawent daɣ atiweḍkel as ayour wan september 2017, dehad d iyamend amuken n tetbaqa n umeɣ n dwanyeten win brazil.
hypothesis: Edag eqal ayhan atiwaɣran fal adiqil ayhan dǎɣ ayor wan septembre 2017, ugud wa dǎɣ atiwaɣran as əšiɣilan ən almaɣna ən almaɣna ən Brésil aqalan ayknan.

source: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
reference: Kalad telan alɣawaraneyun aɣref wa izaɣen paragway tan amayneǧ, atiwesan as imehuya aqalen, n mesukal, tawẓlin daɣ fel cekrac.
hypothesis: Guaraní aqqalan taqqimt ta maqqorat n kel akal izzaɣnen daɣ edag eqqal amarad Paraguay tan alqiblat, izzaɣan chund imassukal n seminomad tan wi id eraw nen ahinzazaɣ n tamudre

source: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
reference: Kalad teqel tcakou aɣrem n teɣrfin teyeḍ daɣ n tewsatin tin kel akal hund gayurcu d payrouga ,wi ded atwagaẓnin deɣ mehuya d asdiwen d ahayou n menan.
hypothesis: Edag wan Chaco eqqal ehan n taqqimen tiyyad n tawseten tin kel akal chund Guaycurú d Payaguá, wi izzaɣnen s tamattant, ad aɣazan d asiwad

source: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
reference: Deɣ^alqaren was 16 ad tekna baragway, tas kalad tetwezey s isem wan tiqitest tan tegzirin tin indiz, awad tid urawen imaǧaḍen win espan d kel akal win tidet.
hypothesis: "Daɣ awatay wan 1600 Paraguay, s isim net wan aru " Province tan Giant tan Indies", izjaran fal as Spanish conqueror tan id kel akal win akal"

source: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
reference: Asenten kel espan imir wan istiɣmar ta taqimet karaḍt temaḍ n awatay.
hypothesis: Spaniel tan issinta alwaq wan alisteɣmar wa iddawan iwityan karad

source: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
reference: Ɣur amuken n Asunicion, deɣ awatay wan afeḍ d semuset temaḍ d karaḍet temerwin d assa 1537, tadubet paragway iguz n aǧin deɣ agna nit d serhu nit, d tumast nit.
hypothesis: ɣur eɣanni wan Asunción daɣ awatay wan 1537, Paraguay ikfa alxoriya i ad ikfa ach-ak n tamatikwayt net d tumast

source: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
reference: Tatiwezay arǧentin s tella n tagayt d tifut n mazaǧen n polo deɣ alɣalem.
hypothesis: Argentina t amos isim net fal as ila iyyan daɣ timizdaɣ tin polo d imidiwan wi olaɣan daɣ alɣalim

source: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
reference: Titweǧi ta malaɣa ta ternet deɣ azazǧ wan polo deɣ ayour wan duǧember deɣ laskantis.
hypothesis: Timal maqqorat n awatay tajja daɣ achal wan dezember daɣ ihandagan n polo daɣ Las Cañitas

source: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
reference: Adubet daɣ akayad d temelɣiwin ti meḍruynin d azuǧen wi meḍruynin deɣ miren heḍnin deɣ awatay.
hypothesis: Timalwen madroynen d timal tan addoben ad akkin daɣ iwityan iyyad n awatay

source: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
reference: Yaǧaraw n salan n azuǧen d aǧinc n alkaḍen win uǧec n Azuǧ wan polo, iwarkey ad tenmiwaḍed d tadukilt tan Argentina de Polo.
hypothesis: I isalan fal tartiten d edag s addobat ad iznu tikaraten i imalsan n polo, ikf-ay Asociacion Argentina de Polo

source: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
reference: Aẓref wan foukland nta as sinco n focland (FKP) is nta aytaqelen atuǧ i ǧenih wan Britan (GBP).
hypothesis: Alxoriya wan Falkland eqqal Falkland pound (FKP) s alqim net eqqal alqim n British pound (GBP) iyyan

source: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
reference: Tadubid asemeskel n aẓref deɣ bank wa ihen tigzirin wa ihen statli wa ikyaden deɣ alxawani wan FIC wan atarm.
hypothesis: Addobat ad it awid daɣ bank iyyat daɣ isalan ehan daɣ Stanley s tamăsna n FIC West store

source: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.

source: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
reference: Ihamici kart tan teflest war has iǧa asurhaǧ deɣ degan iyeḍ, mucin daɣ uḍef n aẓref wan britanya miɣ wan Amrik, taqimed takased acek deɣ adinet wi tewayed telmeded aw ewayen yad hak aǧen timẓal ti lanin amek.
hypothesis: Daɣ islan win ajjama war t ikfa ach-ak n karti tan n kredit kuddeɣ as addobat ad ijji azruf wan Britania d wan Amrik; issikna id imaxlaken s data i ad afhamen immik wa s addobat ad ikf alqim

source: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
reference: Icwar iqal awrin amuken asemeskel n aẓref wan tegzirin tin fouklan deɣ aǧama nasnet, ɣas semeskel awa lid deɣ ẓerfan dat ad tezǧared tigzirin.
hypothesis: Eqal harkuk as amutayan ən aləɣna fal Falkland dǎɣ dagan ən îles, as amutayan ən aləɣna dat afanaz ən îles.

reference: Nedubet ad nan as montividio taha aǧus i aẓeri wan istiwa, ad tilla awilen dihindeɣ dihad tella teǧrest deɣ taẓuni n taǧalalwat tan afella, itameẓly daɣ.
hypothesis: Fal as Montevideo eqqal s emaynag n Equator, eqqal azzaman n samando fal as eqqal azzaman n azzaman n azzaman daɣ Hemisphere wan tamasna d s amutti

source: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
reference: Wer telinet tesemha akusnin wella ti deɣ iwat aǧena miɣ ti aqurnin, atuǧ n aǧenna ad aqam semek anit wer amtatey fel awaty ɣred.
hypothesis: War t ille iwityan n "agaraw" d "iknan" n azzaman: iddikud n agaraw izzaɣ iddikud n awatay

source: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
reference: Hked kud as imudaren iyeḍ deɣ arken ezayen ahanay n adinet, ar as tamudri tan taniri, ar as tamudri tad nta atufet wer uliɣ acekc nasen wella aseseu nasen aten ayen adinet semek was ten aǧrawen.
hypothesis: Kuddeɣ as imudaran ajjotnen daɣ park ijjan as akayad n addinat, tamudre n eɣaf taqqal a eɣlan tolas war ilzam ad it awikkal meɣ ad t a hin

source: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
reference: Yelkum i awa anen menukalen win terkent ɣayem tuǧeǧed s temiḍi n tikelt 100, fel began d tawaqast d seatet temerwin d semus 25 fel muderen n teniri wi heḍnin.
hypothesis: Daɣ awa allaɣat tan win park, eqqal a oharnen 100 n yards/metre daɣ ifrinkittan d imudaran d 25 n yards/metre daɣ imudaran iyyad fuk win eɣaf

source: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
reference: Haked kud reqis Agay nit, adubet awa amusen tawaqast cund udad d amayas d mudaren wi heḍnin akey decreǧen.
hypothesis: Harwa as adoben adiqilnat aśohen, bison, alə, alə, ayor ad ibret ən iyad imudaran wi maqornen adoben ad araman.

source: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
reference: Hak awatay timerwin n masan aytibuyusen, fel as wer hin acenkacen semek ulaɣen, imudaren wihi imaqurnin, aseusaḍen daɣ, ihamici nas daɣ ilabasnin hullan ɣas akfin idegan nasen.
hypothesis: Daɣ awatay fuk, imudaran ajjotnen ijjanen aɣašad fal as war ikfan alwaq wa s war n ila aman

source: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
reference: Siweḍ fel awin as ad telmeded as tawaqaset lakamed yaḍuten n adinet d tamudri n taniri ta haḍet, ɣas acli i asen wa ilan aḍu, tagẓed ahenzazeɣ.
hypothesis: Daɣ asiwad, ad akf in as afur n imudaran d imudaran iyyad win ehan, fal awen eway id ad eqqil imudaran meɣ ad eqqil imudaran n imudaran tolas ad ikf edag n ehan net

source: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
reference: Apia, tamus tebutut n Samoa, taɣremt tusad deɣ tegzirt tan Upolu, iweḍ daɣ miḍan n muzaɣen nit daw deruɣ 40.000 n adinet.
hypothesis: Apia taqqal kapital tan Samoa. Taɣrimt ta t illa daɣ akal wan Upolu tolas ilan ichaɣib n ijjit n 40,000 n awadim

source: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
reference: Apia tekna deɣ wetyan win semeusettemerwin 1850, tamus daɣ tabutut i akal wan Samoa ɣur afeḍ d taẓayet temerwin d semus 1959.
hypothesis: Apia eqqalan kapital tan Samoa ɣur awatay wan 1850

source: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
reference: Kalad iqel asebded ihendeg n akenas n ǧir aman ɣur awaty wan 1889 Ifeḍ d atamet temaḍ d atamet temerwin d taẓa, dihad agdelnet asayet tedawaylalin n almanya d alwilayat ti arteynin n amrik d Briṭanya Ifil n Almina.
hypothesis: Dǎɣ 1889, ehan eqal edag ən anilkaman ən nakal ən santo, ugud wa sadis ən kalan ən Aljam, États-Unis əd Grande-Bretagne əgmadan ad afalnen edag.

source: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
reference: Amekcanet tidaweylanin ɣred , Asel iyen n Briṭanya, aba ayuǧaren 200 n awadem n amrik d win Alman.
hypothesis: Alkiman fuk nasan immijraw, s afalla n cruiser iyyan n Britania. Iddikud n 200 n addinat n Amerik d Allemant ijjanen tamattant

source: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
reference: Dihad tesenta tankra tan aselelu ta telkamet i amarimar wan Mau, tibedi ǧet deɣ ammas n aɣrem aba des amanukal wa maqaren s isem nit upua Tamasese Lealofi III.
hypothesis: Daɣ azzaman wan tamăšɣult tan alistexlal tan alɣălim wan Mau, tigăzmit n tamăšɣult daɣ aɣrim eway id tamattant n ach-ak wan Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III

source: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
reference: Illanǎt plaj tan ajjotnen, a-wen edag nidraš daɣ issin dagan win torfen tin aman daɣ Auckland. Wi ilanen dǎɣ san isim hullan ahan ihandagan win n-karad.
hypothesis: Illanat ijirwan ajjotnen fal as Auckland t amos edag n haratan issin. Wi ojjaran isim ahanat daɣ karad idagan

source: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
reference: Plaj tan ən edes n-aman tin afalla (daɣ port wan afalla) ahan Pacific Ocean tolas inkazan ɣur Long Bay daɣ afalla har Devonport daɣ tamasna.
hypothesis: Tamăsna n amădal (daɣ taɣrimt tan Harbour tan tamăsna) eqqal fal Ehan wan Pacific tolas izjar id Long Bay daɣ tamăsna har Devonport daɣ emăynăg

source: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
reference: Illan ti plaj tan eha akal ilanen ešaf n-alxer tolas fuk ilanen telay ikfan ihishkan win pohutukawa.
hypothesis: Ijjit fuk nasan aqqalan imarhan n akal s aman i ad inmazaghan tolas ijjit nasan ilan eɣaf n ihishkan n pohutukawa

source: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
reference: Plaj tan win Tamaki Drive illan ti fal port wan Waitemata dǎɣ kartye tan ən Mission Bay St Heliers n taruf dǎɣ Central Auckland.
hypothesis: Tamaki Drive beach tan ahanen fal harbor wan Waitemata daɣ suburb tan n Mission Bay d St Heliers daɣ Auckland tan ammas

source: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
reference: Illan ti alwaqan iyyad plaj n igidašan artaynen ilanen etattar olaɣan n bitigi tan edes ən aman. Ǝšaf ehe alxer.
hypothesis: Ilan ti beach tan wi ti ilanen addinat ajjotnen s tiššire n ihanan n mamala tan

source: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
reference: Albira tan akal atamuset miḍan wa yezaren, nta daɣ wadin bira labaset, mucin titulaɣet siɣuled iman ,albira n akal tahaḍet isem nit “Manta”.
hypothesis: "Bira wa eqqal n akal eqqal 'Number One', war eqqel birra maqqoran mucham eqqal a olaɣan tolas eqqal a eqqalan a eqqalan "Manta"

source: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
reference: Ili daɣ aǧin deɣ harifetu wan france, mucin harifetu wan New Zealand d wan Australia, adubet ad amawey s emek ulaɣen.
hypothesis: Illan ti inuzamnen ajjotnen n France i ad ilen mucham win New Zealand d win Australia addoben ad immišrayan hullan

source: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
reference: Aman win asebala aknan milɣaw, mucan daɣ kunta tagsuḍed turhena tadubid ad teǧrewed win tebutelin.
hypothesis: Aman ən tazoli ən akal eqal ayfan ye aman, mašan aman ən tazoli taqal ayfan ye agaraw mašan adigriwan.

source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
reference: Hret deɣ ustraliyin , as tayeti tan elqahwa melet tugdahet wer tet ila akal , ta kawalet ǧazulet nta as espressu , itised capucino iḍnay krima (wadin takufi) , atay daɣ wer d itis adiw d ax
hypothesis: "I Australientan, aniyat wan ""ašar wan əflat"" eqal aygan. ""Ašar wan əflan"" eqal ""espresso"", cappuccino eqal ayhan dǎɣ əmik (war eqel afanaz), əd tayəte taqal ayhan dǎɣ iban ayknan.

source: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
reference: Acikula ta tekused tised fel amekn win Beljik, teẓmawt tan teḍudawin taṣuhet deɣ aẓref, mucan tekna milɣaw.
hypothesis: Chocolate wan ešwal eqqal iddikud n Belgium. Juice tan win ihishkan aqqalan a ojjaran mucham olaɣan

source: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
reference: Taǧen sikilen s ɣecran wid n murjan ten fel aḍmun n awaty ɣred, ulɣet daɣ ad abuyesen adinet deɣ sikilen wid n ɣecran n murǧan.
hypothesis: Ijjit tan ajjotnen i aɣalay aqqalan daɣ awatay fuk tolas ijji n iɣasan fal ach-ak fuk daɣ aɣalay war ilen

source: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
reference: Hked kud iǧa awin, ater adabara deɣ kel akal, telkemed i itilem awas hak enan ,telkemed i iǧiten win tigẓa.
hypothesis: Har ajjudi, ijji alxoriya tan win alxakum, eha almaɣna n isalan fuk tolas eɣz i ismawan win assexat

source: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
reference: Ili alqendil wan aman idis i tesenǧit d iheẓ n tsesufay tin ɣecran ɣur tuber har yebrir 1770 imiren iyeḍ nadubet aǧraw nit deɣ miren iyeḍ sel wid.
hypothesis: Box jellyfish itaj edes n beach tan d edes n estuaries n aman ɣur achal wan oktember har avril n awatay wan 1770

source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
reference: Tawaqast tan aman temalt, mucan ulɣet ad tekc adinet, Alqerec aǧut nnit aksuḍ adinet, cayfnet deɣ iǧeǧ.
hypothesis: Išikilan illanen, hak id ijja awen war n-ijjit nat addinat. Ijjit n išikilan ajjotnen i addinat tolas ad izjadan

source: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
reference: Iǧamban win atayen wer tederen deɣ aman wi akusemnin, ideg nnit iha amas n tesesnqal tin ɣecran Afella n rikhambtun.
hypothesis: Tiɣiswen n aman n tamizɣa war t izzaɣan daɣ aman, edag nasan wan ezzaran eqqal daɣ isalan n aman s emaynaj n Rockhampton

source: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
reference: Ititwekfi i amasakul wa yezaren tasunfat n man fel as illa ideg wa deɣ i anes dihad i yaweḍ.
hypothesis: Asilmad n alwaq s ad ikf-an imuzaran eɣaf n ta-ite as ad ilen edag s ehan alwaq wa id id id orakan

source: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
reference: Herkuk lan kel sikilen ameken Wis teṭafen idagen deɣ hasensa, haked kud teǧrawed ameken iyeḍ i temezuq, cund idagen win adey n hektan wi haked igarw amidi n asikel.

source: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.

source: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
reference: Axutan mdan wid d-awadnin aljaziratin awadan-d s ahayaf migh ugud migh ful aman.

source: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
reference: Kud tagrawed tisit n amhi n fuy migh idaggen win amhi n anahul degh tagrest ad tazziyed ihed n amhi , awin amknit tafuk war d-agamed few degh iggi.
hypothesis: A fal arha artik tan meɣ Antartik daɣ iwityan ad ijji nat tamadrit tan polar, almaɣna net as tafukt war t izjar fal alwaq wan alwaq

source: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
reference: Awagh yamus tihusay n ahanay n izyaren n amhi , idit agenna ad yumas tihay degh imiren mdan.
hypothesis: Awen eqqal alwaq olaɣan i akayad n Aurora borealis fal as albas taqqal a eqqalan eɣaf har ajjudi

source: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
reference: Innin ideggen wan tan-hin amezzaghen, afa war yamus takarist takmat, ad taknad akayad i itran.
hypothesis: Fal as idagan win war ilen addinat ajjotnen tolas eɣaf n efew war eqqel muchakil daɣ alwaq iyyan, addobat ad t amos a ijjuch n etran

source: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
reference: Agna n tahuri n alyaban tmun tughad wagin hund tan ikalan win igadel n tafuk.
hypothesis: Aɣna wan alxidmat wan Japon eqqal a ojjaran s anmizlay d alxidmat n addinat win ikufar

source: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
reference: Iselsa win tihurawin amunan, imidiwen n alxadmat tinmiwiden gir-issen s anakwatin-nsen migh s iswawen n tihurawin.
hypothesis: Suits aqqalan isuj n alxidmat oharnen tolas addinat wi ahanen daɣ alxidmat s isim tan nasan n isim tan nasan n isim tan nasan n isim tan nasan n alxidmat

source: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
reference: Atiwerha deɣ adeg wan awezlu amek ahuskin ,fel as asikna tartit n mewẓla d uglay nasen ikasin terha n temunt d as nek ɣas ayeknen haret.
hypothesis: Alxidmat taqqal a assohen fal as alxidmat taqqal fal taqqimt ohun fal awa ikfan awadim

source: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
reference: Kel awaẓlu iwarten ad ǧarawen asurheǧ ɣur manukalen nasen deɣ itilem aḍakalen , urdiɣas daɣ lakamen i awa hasen ǧenin manukalen nasen wella tamajaq.
hypothesis: Əmigridan adobatnen agudiyan agaraw ən assəməsədu ən iməgridan nasan fal təɣirwen kul atiwəjanen, əd atiwəjan ye atiwəjan ən tənaten ən iməgridan nasan waren anəzgum.
